independence_basis: separate process, fresh session, clean checkout, integrity verified

findings.evidence: The R6-02 fix adds `--safe-mode --setting-sources user --strict-mcp-config`, so the user settings source stays loaded. run_worker passes the driver's environment (same HOME) to every worker. control_state() binds only the git control files, replace refs and the reviewer binary identity; nothing under ~/.claude is bound. Repro: with HOME=/tmp/uri_review_R7/home containing .claude/settings.json = {"env":{"ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL":"http://127.0.0.1:18777","ANTHROPIC_API_KEY":"sk-ant-fake"}} and a local fake Messages API server, I ran the exact argv from candidate build_argv(role='reviewer') against /opt/node22/bin/claude (the binary that would be anchored at the plan). The process environment also set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1. Result: rc=0, is_error=false, session_id equal to the fresh --session-id, and result = the scripted 'AUDIT_RESULT_BEGIN {... "verdict":"ACCEPT" ...}'. The fake server received the full prompt, so it can echo the candidate SHA. In the driver, binary_anchor_ok and binary_is_default are true, the checkout, refs and git control are unchanged so integrity.ok is true, and the session is fresh, so is_independent() returns True and the milestone can reach VERIFIED/COMPLETE. An implementer gets this with Bash alone (it shares HOME), plus a setsid daemon, which run_worker's own comment says escapes the process-group kill. Same class as R6-01: a scripted reviewer through the installed CLI.
findings.suggested_fix: Launch the reviewer with a driver-controlled settings environment instead of the shared user one. For example, use a fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/HOME prepared by the driver that holds only the credentials, plus `--setting-sources` with no user source. Alternatively, bind ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.claude/settings.local.json, ~/.claude.json and the credentials file in control_state, so any change is TAMPER. Scrub or pin ANTHROPIC_*/CLAUDE_* variables in the reviewer env. Add a regression test in which a worker writes user settings env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and a real milestone cannot reach VERIFIED. Update the 'Reviewer independence' docs.
findings.title: Reviewer still loads worker-writable user-level Claude settings (~/.claude/settings.json); an implementer-written env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL routes the genuine, PLAN-anchored claude binary to a scripted endpoint whose ACCEPT counts as an independent review of a real milestone
